meta.title: BBMED Packaging Operations Intelligence
meta.method: Precomputed from supplied cleaned Excel workbooks. Dashboard runtime uses this compact JSON; original workbooks are retained in source-data/.

energy.unit: raw meter units (unit metadata not supplied)

definitions.expectedRuntime: Ordered quantity / order-master target rate; not a validated schedule. Runtime overrun = max(usage minutes − expected runtime, 0)
definitions.lostHours: Sum of max(period usage hours − period production hours, 0); overlaps stoppage measures
definitions.laborProductivity: Produced units / sum(WorkerCount × usage hours); staffing coverage incomplete
definitions.matchRate: Matched orders / selected MES orders; Excel-only counts remain global
definitions.energyAllocation: Consecutive meter deltas distributed to unique order timestamp overlaps, assuming constant consumption inside each meter interval; gaps and ambiguous overlaps remain unallocated
definitions.packagingCost: Unavailable: requires packaging consumption and effective unit prices
definitions.quality: Produced / (Produced + recorded rejects); sparse reject records mean this is a proxy
definitions.disturbance: Type-1 MES stoppages joined by WorkRecordID
definitions.reconciliation: MES order totals vs manual Excel order totals
definitions.energy: Sum of valid consecutive deltas per meter; negative resets and conflicting/invalid samples excluded and counted. Raw unit unspecified
